name: Fest-off
source:
You attend a festival celebration with your choice of Shinpachi or Yamazaki and have fun plus fluffy moments that are written true to the characters from the game.

Shinpachi and Yamazaki have three scenes total and there are no bad endings.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31430]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
